name_reason: Already compliant: data_fd2_ prefix (game global), battle domain (pathfind is part of the battle subsystem; readers/writers are AI + player-action callers), descriptor pathfind_dst_x clearly states it is the pathfind destination tile X. The _x suffix is a coordinate-axis label, not a Ghidra address residue (0x60071 has no _71/_60071 hex-suffix match). Scalar byte coordinate; name reads as a coordinate field, appropriate for the data type.
purpose: Pathfind destination tile X (target column): the column the path-aware search is trying to reach; compared against the current search position to detect arrival.
logic_summary: Single unsigned byte in BSS (.object3), first field of the dst_x(0x60071)/dst_y(0x60072) pair. Written only by the path-aware orchestrator fd2_pathfind_to_destination at entry (MOV [0x60071],AL from arg [EBP+0x1C], i.e. dst_x truncated to low byte, at 0x4E1D6); the plain flood-fill orchestrator fd2_init_movement_range_floodfill never sets it. Read by fd2_pathfind_check_destination_save_path as the destination column compared to the current x (CMP DL,[0x60071] at 0x4E401) to decide whether the search reached the destination. Write-before-read, so the load-time zero is never observed.
element_semantics: Tile X coordinate (column index) of the pathfind destination; 0..map_width-1. Unsigned. Compared by equality against the current search column.
comment_original_issue: src comment cited the dst_x read site as 0x4E409, but 0x4E409 is the dst_y read (CMP DH,[0x60072]); the dst_x read (CMP DL,[0x60071]) is at 0x4E401 (function entry of fd2_pathfind_check_destination_save_path, the address the READ xref reports). Corrected the cited address. Separately, the prior Ghidra annotation lived in a PRE_COMMENT (not PLATE_COMMENT) and carried a stale 'emit_action = emit_c_const' line that contradicts the live write-xref at 0x4E1D6 (global is written -> non-const); the actual src emit is already a plain non-const uint8, so only the Ghidra annotation was wrong.
notes: Verified writer disasm (0x4E1A6 fd2_pathfind_to_destination): MOV [0x60071],AL <- [EBP+0x1C] (dst_x arg). Verified reader disasm (0x4E401 fd2_pathfind_check_destination_save_path): CMP DL,[0x60071] then CMP DH,[0x60072]. xrefs: WRITE 0x4E1D6, READ 0x4E401 (matches src comment after address fix). Datatype byte/len 1, value 0 at load (BSS .object3). Replaced stale PRE_COMMENT (wrong field + stale emit_c_const) with a correct PLATE_COMMENT noting non-const; save_program succeeded. No logic changed; only the one-word/address note in the dst_x comment block edited.
